item.title: Palm Springs: (Second Reading/ Second Public Hearing) Ordinance No. 2026-07 - Voluntary Annexation — 1580 Prairie Road:…
item.description: Palm Springs Village Council, 2026-11-19. On the agenda; no vote recorded. (Second Reading/ Second Public Hearing) Ordinance No. 2026-07 - Voluntary Annexation — 1580 Prairie Road: Motion to approve the application submitted by Urban Design Studio, acting as agent for the applicants and contract purchaser, FL Residential Solution, LLC. The applicants are requesting the voluntary annexation of the property at 1580 Prairie Road into the Village of Palm Springs, pursuant to Section 171.044, Florida Statutes.

item.description: Palm Springs Village Council, 2026-11-19. On the agenda; no vote recorded. Voluntary annexation of the subject property is requested. ​
